result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial road with a car-centric design and significant crossing distances. While sidewalks are present and buffered by on-street parking on the right, the lack of marked crossings and the scale of the roadway prioritize vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway creates a long, unprotected distance for pedestrians to traverse without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, which may lead to unsafe mid-block crossing attempts.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway stretch

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right curb can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the curb

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time, reducing exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk and Signage
interventions.description: Implement a marked crossing with high-visibility 'continental' markings and pedestrian crossing warning signs.

result.summary: The image shows a typical urban street with a continuous paved sidewalk and parallel on-street parking. While the sidewalk is in good condition and buffered by trees, the presence of a large surface parking lot entrance creates a significant conflict point for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: The line of parallel parked cars can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of motorists in the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground along the curb line

hazards.name: Wide driveway conflict zone
hazards.description: The wide entrance to the surface parking lot creates a large area where turning vehicles may conflict with pedestrians on the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Middle ground, right side of the sidewalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to narrow the roadway at potential crossing points, improving visibility and shortening crossing distances.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing and Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the parking lot entrance and use tighter corner radii to slow turning vehicles and minimize the pedestrian exposure area.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide multi-lane roadway with a dedicated bike lane and a substantial sidewalk on the left, but it lacks visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals at the intersection. The presence of a large blank building frontage and the significant crossing distance without a refuge island reduce the overall safety and comfort for people walking.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The roadway is very wide with at least four travel lanes and a bike lane, requiring pedestrians to cross a long distance without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no visible painted crosswalks at the intersection, which fails to designate a safe path for pedestrians and reduces driver awareness.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of Front St and the cross street

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The large brick building on the right creates a long stretch of blank wall, reducing natural surveillance and pedestrian interest.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks at all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

result.summary: The environment is a high-speed multi-lane arterial road with minimal pedestrian protection. A narrow sidewalk exists on the far side but lacks any buffer from traffic, and there are no visible crossing facilities for a very wide roadway.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median refuge or marked crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the entire width of the foreground roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to high-speed travel lanes with no planting strip or parked cars to provide separation.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the edge of the blue and tan building on the far side of the street

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes encourage high vehicle speeds in an area with industrial frontages.

interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to improve driver yielding rates.

interventions.description: Add a buffer zone with trees or bollards between the sidewalk and the roadway to improve pedestrian comfort and safety.
